title: Hiring debrief — candidates, feedback, corrections
raw: okay interview debrief for the senior engineer role so we had three candidates today first was carlos he has eight years of experience mostly in fintech and his system design was really strong like top tier but his coding was slower than i'd like and he made a mistake in the tree traversal problem that he didn't catch until i hinted and overall i'd say hire no wait strong lean hire he's good just not perfect second was priya ten years of experience she was actually the strongest technical candidate we've had in this round her coding was clean and fast and she asked really good clarifying questions and her system design showed she's thought about scale which is rare and i'd say strong hire but she mentioned she has two other offers so we need to move fast and the third was james he was fine uh competent but not exceptional and there were some communication gaps like he struggled to explain his reasoning out loud which is a concern for our team culture and i'd say no hire for now but he might be a better fit for a junior or mid level role
reference:
Interview debrief — senior engineer role, three candidates today.

Carlos: 8 years, mostly fintech. System design was top-tier, but coding was slower than I'd like and he missed a bug in the tree traversal problem until I hinted. Decision: strong lean hire.

Priya: 10 years. Strongest technical candidate in this round — coding was clean and fast, great clarifying questions, and her system design showed she's thought about scale. Has two other offers so we need to move fast. Decision: strong hire.

James: Competent but not exceptional. Struggled to explain his reasoning out loud, which is a concern for our team culture. Decision: no hire for now, but might be a better fit for a junior or mid-level role.
